website.notes: Official site fetched 2026-10-09 (HTTP 200, both jioskill.com and www.jioskill.com). Site self-describes as an IT-services + EdTech/training company; careers page headline 'Be part of India's leading EdTech company'; footer contact contact@jioskill.com, 'Bengaluru, Karnataka'. About page (https://www.jioskill.com/about, fetched 2026-10-09): claims 'Bengaluru-based ... founded in 2019', '5+ Years in Business', mission 'bridge the gap between what educational institutions teach and what the industry actually needs' / 'bridge the gap between education and employment', values Excellence / Community / Integrity / Innovation, dual pillars IT services + 1-month internships with live projects, office address only 'Bengaluru, Karnataka' (no street address), WhatsApp +91 63922 31675, hours Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00 IST. Careers page stat block claims 50+ team members, 10K+ students trained, 15+ cities, 4.8 Glassdoor rating; homepage claims 'Trusted by 100+ companies', '5000+ students', '90% placement rate', 'Recognized by 5000+/500+ companies', Skill India / ISO 9001:2015 / MSME certificate backing. RELIABILITY CAVEATS observed in-page: homepage and about-page counters render as '0+' in static HTML (JS-animated, no server-side numbers), several marketing images are placeholders (/placeholder.jpg), partner-logo strips are duplicated marquee content, and the 'Recognition & Awards' block (Best IT Training Provider 2023 - Karnataka Tech Awards; Top 50 Startups to Watch - YourStory; Most Student-Friendly Platform - EdTech India; Excellence in Digital Services - NASSCOM) carries no links or verifiable citations. Treat all headcount, placement-rate, student-count, partner, and award figures as SELF-ASSERTED and DO NOT cite them in application materials. Only safe-to-reference facts: Bengaluru-based EdTech platform, the stated mission wording above, the values trio/quartet, the internship/live-project/webinar model, contact email. A second property, admin.jioskill.com (About Us / Courses / Blog), serves a related but visually distinct site (6 one-month internship courses: AI, Python, Java, App Dev, Web Dev, Digital Marketing) and also claims the education-to-employment mission; its 'About Us' page claims the platform connects students with internships and employers. Not yet reconciled with www.jioskill.com - treat as the same brand but do not cite cross-domain details.

media.notes: Fetched 2026-10-09. Vendor case study: Amzsoft Innovexa (Dubai / Indiranagar, Bangalore) claims it designed, built, and shipped jioskill.com in 2024 using Next.js, React, Node.js, and describes JioSkill as an 'IT services and EdTech platform trusted by 100+ businesses across India ... serving 5000+ students across Java, Python, Web Dev, and AI & ML tracks'. This is the builder's own marketing copy, not independent journalism - it corroborates the tech stack of the marketing site and the platform's dual IT-services/positioning, but its 100+ businesses / 5000+ students figures are the same self-reported numbers and must not be cited as third-party validation. No press coverage (YourStory, NASSCOM, Economic Times, etc.) could be located for any claimed award; Wikipedia has no article. No funding announcements found. No independent media source located - leave media claims out of the application entirely.

network_contacts_note: No network contacts on record for Jioskill (workspace has no contacts/directory entries for this company). Reviewer summary for the drafter: the 'no verifiable public presence' premise given to the drafter is OUT OF DATE - jioskill.com resolves, is reachable without a 403, and hosts the exact Frontend Developer posting being applied to, so the company is identifiable and its own mission/values/platform description are quotable. What remains weak is corroboration: headcount, founding year, student counts, placement rate, awards, and the Glassdoor rating are all self-asserted or snippet-only and mutually inconsistent (site: founded 2019 / 50+ staff / Bengaluru; LinkedIn snippet: founded 2024 / 1 person; Internshala snippet: Lucknow). Practical rule for this application: reference only the mission and the EdTech-platform framing ('your EdTech platform', 'bridge the gap between education and employment'), never numbers, never awards, never headcount. Also note the posting itself is the company's own copy, so quoting its requirement language back is safe. Every company-specific claim landing in the cover letter still needs a final re-fetch of the cited URL per 03-writing-style.md rule 5; the cache is a lead, not a citation.
